Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. demographic (adj/n)
/ˌdeməˈɡræfɪk/
thuộc về nhân khẩu học (cơ cấu dân số theo độ tuổi, giới tính, thu nhập); n: nhóm nhân khẩu
Collocation: demographic shift, ageing demographic, demographic trend
"Japan and Italy are experiencing a dramatic demographic shift towards an older society."
2. elderly (adj/n)
/ˈeldəli/
cao tuổi, lớn tuổi (the elderly = người cao tuổi nói chung, trang trọng hơn 'old people')
Collocation: the elderly population, care for the elderly, elderly citizens
"The pie charts illustrate that the elderly will account for over a quarter of the population by 2050."
3. fertility (n)
/fəˈtɪləti/
khả năng sinh sản, tỷ suất sinh (fertility rate)
Collocation: declining fertility rate, total fertility rate, boost fertility
"A sharply declining fertility rate has caused the proportion of children to shrink in many developed nations."
4. expectancy (n)
/ɪkˈspektənsi/
kỳ vọng, tuổi thọ trung bình (life expectancy)
Collocation: life expectancy, average life expectancy, increase life expectancy
"Thanks to modern medical treatment, average life expectancy has risen above eighty years."
5. pension (n)
/ˈpenʃn/
lương hưu, quỹ hưu trí
Collocation: state pension, draw a pension, pension fund, retirement pension
"As more workers retire, governments struggle to fund state pensions and elderly healthcare."
6. workforce (n)
/ˈwɜːkfɔːs/
lực lượng lao động (tổng số người trong độ tuổi lao động của một quốc gia)
Collocation: shrinking workforce, skilled workforce, enter the workforce
"A shrinking working-age workforce means fewer taxpayers to support public services."
7. migration (n)
/maɪˈɡreɪʃn/
sự di cư (dịch chuyển dân cư giữa các vùng hoặc quốc gia)
Collocation: rural-to-urban migration, international migration, skilled migration
"Many European nations encourage skilled migration to offset their declining workforce."
8. fraction (n)
/ˈfrækʃn/
phân số; một phần rất nhỏ (từ khóa mô tả miếng bánh nhỏ trong Task 1 Pie Chart)
Collocation: a tiny fraction, a small fraction of the total, represent a fraction
"Citizens aged over 85 represented only a tiny fraction (3%) of the national population in 2000."
9. segment (n)
/ˈseɡmənt/
phân khúc, phần cắt (của biểu đồ tròn Pie Chart hoặc nhóm dân số)
Collocation: the largest segment, population segment, each segment of the pie chart
"Working-age adults constituted by far the largest segment of the pie chart in both years."
10. majority (n)
/məˈdʒɒrəti/
đại đa số, phần lớn (> 50% đến 85% trong biểu đồ tròn)
Collocation: the vast majority of, account for the majority, a clear majority
"In 2025, adults aged 15 to 64 accounted for the vast majority of the population, at 66%."
11. minority (n)
/maɪˈnɒrəti/
thiểu số, phần nhỏ (trong tổng thể dân số hoặc biểu đồ)
Collocation: a small minority of, ethnic minority, represent a minority
"Only a small minority of retirees (12%) continued working part-time after age sixty-five."
12. quarter (n)
/ˈkwɔːtə(r)/
một phần tư (25% — cách quy đổi số % sang phân số chuẩn Band 7.5+ Pie Chart)
Collocation: roughly a quarter (24-26%), nearly a quarter (23-24%), three-quarters (75%)
"By 2050, the elderly segment is projected to make up roughly a quarter (26%) of the total population."
13. project (v)
/prəˈdʒekt/
dự báo, ước tính trong tương lai (dùng cho biểu đồ có năm tương lai 2040, 2050)
Collocation: be projected to + V, projected figure, demographers project that
"The proportion of children under 14 is projected to decline from 22% to 14% by 2050."
14. shrink (v)
/ʃrɪŋk/
thu hẹp lại, co nhỏ lại (quá khứ: shrank, phân từ: shrunk — mô tả miếng Pie Chart nhỏ đi)
Collocation: shrink dramatically, a shrinking workforce, shrink by half
"Between 2000 and 2050, the youth segment is forecast to shrink from nearly a third to just 14%."
15. burden (n/v)
/ˈbɜːdn/
gánh nặng (tài chính, y tế, thuế khóa)
Collocation: financial burden, place a heavy burden on, ease the burden
"A rapidly ageing population places a heavy financial burden on public healthcare and pension systems."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: IELTS Writing Task 1 (Pie Chart) — Quy Đổi Phần Trăm (%) Sang Phân Số & Cụm Tỷ Trọng

• Tại sao không được chỉ chép lại số % trong bài Pie Chart? Nếu bạn viết 25%, 33%, 51%, 74% suốt cả bài, giám khảo sẽ chấm điểm từ vựng (Lexical Resource) rất thấp vì chỉ chép lại đề. Để đạt Band 7.0+, bạn phải kết hợp Cụm Phân Số (Fractions) + Số % trong ngoặc:

• Bảng Quy Đổi Vàng Cho Biểu Đồ Tròn (Pie Chart Conversion Table):
  - 75% – 85%: the vast majority of / roughly three-quarters of (74%)
  - 65% – 67%: approximately two-thirds of (66%)
  - 48% – 52%: just under half (48%) / roughly half (50%) / just over half (52%)
  - 32% – 34%: approximately one-third of (33%)
  - 24% – 26%: roughly a quarter of (25%) / just over a quarter (26%)
  - 10% – 15%: a small minority of (12%)
  - 2% – 5%: a tiny fraction of (3%)

• 4 Cụm Động từ Mô tả Miếng bánh Pie Chart: account for = make up = constitute = represent + [Phân số / Số %].

🔵 Tầng 2: Cấu Trúc Dự Báo Tương Lai (Future Projections 2040/2050) Trong Task 1

• Bẫy thời gian trong Pie Chart có năm tương lai (VD: 2025 vs 2050): Khi mô tả biểu đồ năm 2050, tuyệt đối không dùng quá khứ đơn và hạn chế lặp từ will. Hãy dùng cấu trúc Bị động Dự báo (Passive Projections):

• Công thức 1: S + is / are + projected / forecast / expected + to + V (nguyên mẫu)
  Ví dụ: By 2050, the elderly segment is projected to double, rising from 13% to just over a quarter (26%).

• Công thức 2: It is projected / forecast that + S + will + V
  Ví dụ: It is forecast that the working-age workforce will shrink from two-thirds (66%) to 60% by mid-century.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. Japan is experiencing a major ________ shift as the number of retirees surpasses the number of children.
2. Governments need to build more nursing homes and hospitals to care for the growing ________ population.
3. Because young couples are delaying marriage, the national ________ rate has fallen to a record low.
4. Advances in medicine and nutrition have increased average life ________ from 65 to 82 years.
5. Many governments are raising the retirement age from 60 to 65 so that the state ________ fund does not run out of money.
6. A shrinking working-age ________ means factories and hospitals face severe labour shortages.
7. Rural-to-urban ________ has caused big cities to become overcrowded while countryside villages lose young workers.
8. At just 3%, renewable geothermal energy represented only a tiny ________ of total power consumption.
9. Looking at the pie chart, working-age adults formed the largest ________ in both 2000 and 2025.
10. Accounting for 78% of the total, the vast ________ of university students preferred hybrid learning.
11. Only a small ________ of commuters (11%) cycled to work, whereas most people drove cars.
12. At 25%, housing costs accounted for exactly a ________ of average household expenditure.
13. Demographers ________ that the global population will reach nearly ten billion by the year 2050.
14. Due to low birth rates, the proportion of children under 15 is expected to ________ from 28% to 15%.
15. Rising medical costs for chronic illnesses place a heavy financial ________ on young taxpayers.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 20] The table reveals a striking ________ in daily water consumption between Australia and India.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 19] Unless strict anti-poaching laws are enforced, many endangered species will face ________.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 18] Biotechnologists modify crop genetics to boost agricultural ________ during severe droughts.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 17] At the initial stage of the process, cold water is pumped underground and ________ intense heating.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 16] Regular exercise and a healthy diet are the keys to disease prevention and ________.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. By the year 2050, the proportion of elderly citizens ________ to rise from 14% to 26%.
2. At 25% of the total population, children under 14 accounted for exactly ________ of the pie chart in 2000.
3. Representing 66% of the population in 2025, working-age adults made up approximately ________ of the total.
4. Look at the verb tense for future year 2050: It is forecast that the youth segment ________ from 21% to 14% by 2050.
5. In 2025, people aged 15–64 and 65+ accounted for 66% and 13% of the total population ________.
6. ________ the elderly segment is projected to double by 2050, the proportion of children is expected to fall sharply.
7. Only a tiny fraction of retirees (4%) lived in nursing homes, ________ the vast majority (96%) remained in their own homes.
8. Note that 'the elderly' is plural: In many developed nations, the elderly ________ provided with free public healthcare.
9. Encouraging skilled migration helps offset a shrinking workforce, ________ easing the tax burden on young citizens.
10. Working-age adults constituted the largest segment in 2025, ________ for nearly two-thirds (66%) of the population.
Điểm: 0/10

Community Director: Good morning, SilverOak Active Senior Centre, Director Helen Brooks speaking. How can I help you today?
Sociology Student: Hello Ms. Brooks! My name is Lucas Vance. I am conducting a university research survey on our city's ageing demographic and elderly wellbeing.
Community Director: I would be happy to help with your research, Lucas! Could you spell your surname for our visitor log?
Sociology Student: Yes, it is Vance. V - A - N - C - E. 💡 Đáp án câu 1 (Họ sinh viên): VANCE
Community Director: Thank you. What statistics do you need about our senior members?
Sociology Student: First, how has the elderly population in our district changed over the last ten years?
Community Director: It has grown rapidly because life expectancy has risen. Today, residents aged over 65 make up 25%—a full quarter—of our local population. 💡 Đáp án câu 2 (Tỷ lệ người trên 65 tuổi): 25% / a quarter
Sociology Student: A quarter of the district is impressive! What is the most popular daytime activity at your centre?
Community Director: Many people think retirees only play chess, but our Digital Skills class is actually the most popular programme. 💡 Bẫy suy nghĩ thông thường vs thực tế câu 3: Digital Skills
Sociology Student: Do any of your senior members still work part-time to supplement their state pension?
Community Director: Yes! We run a Senior Mentorship scheme where retired engineers and teachers work 12 hours a week advising local businesses. 💡 Đáp án câu 4 (Số giờ làm việc/tuần): 12
Sociology Student: That is a brilliant way to keep experienced people in the workforce! How much is the annual membership fee at SilverOak?
Community Director: For residents receiving a state pension, membership costs just 30 pounds per year. 💡 Đáp án câu 5 (Phí hội viên hàng năm): 30
Sociology Student: Thirty pounds a year is very affordable. Could I visit the centre on Thursday to interview a few members?
Community Director: Certainly! Our centre is located opposite the Central Library. See you on Thursday morning, Lucas! 💡 Đáp án câu 6 (Vị trí trung tâm): Central Library

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - Rising Life Expectancy and Declining Fertility]
Throughout the twenty-first century, industrialized nations have experienced an unprecedented demographic transformation. Driven by breakthroughs in medical care and nutrition, average life expectancy has climbed above eighty years in Europe and East Asia. Simultaneously, birth and fertility rates have fallen well below the replacement level as young adults prioritize careers and delay parenthood. As a result, the elderly segment is expanding rapidly, while the youth population continues to shrink.

[Paragraph B - Pie Chart Projections (2025 versus 2050)]
Population statistics illustrate this dramatic shift clearly. In 2025, working-age adults (aged 15 to 64) accounted for the vast majority of the population in developed nations, at approximately two-thirds (66%), while children under 14 made up 21% and the elderly (65+) represented only a small minority of 13%. By 2050, however, the elderly proportion is projected to double to just over a quarter (26%), whereas the youth segment is forecast to drop to a mere fraction of 14%, leaving a smaller workforce of 60%.

[Paragraph C - Economic Burdens and Policy Solutions]
This ageing trend places a heavy financial burden on governments. As a larger share of citizens retire and draw state pensions, public expenditure on healthcare and nursing homes skyrockets, while tax revenues from the shrinking workforce decline. To ease this burden, economists recommend three policies: gradually raising the statutory retirement age, investing in workplace automation, and encouraging skilled international migration to replenish the labour market.
Điểm: 0/6

✍️ Academic Writing Lab (IELTS Task 1: Pie Chart): So Sánh Cơ Cấu Dân Số Theo 3 Nhóm Tuổi Năm 2025 & Dự Báo Năm 2050

Đề bài: The two pie charts below show the percentage of the population in a developed country across three age segments in 2025 and projections for 2050: [Year 2025: Working-age adults (15–64): 66% | Children (0–14): 21% | Elderly (65+): 13%] • [Year 2050 (Projected): Working-age adults (15–64): 60% | Children (0–14): 14% | Elderly (65+): 26%]. Summarize the main features and make comparisons (95 - 125 words).
